results.name: Behrend.roth_lower_bound
results.source_text:
theorem roth_lower_bound : (N : ℝ) * exp (-4 * √(log N)) ≤ rothNumberNat N := by
  obtain rfl | hN := Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N
  · simp
  obtain h₁ | h₁ := le_or_gt 4096 N
  · exact (roth_lower_bound_explicit h₁).le
  · apply (lower_bound_le_one hN h₁.le).trans
    simpa using! rothNumberNat.monotone hN

results.name: LinearPMap.IsLowerBound
results.source_text:
/-- `IsLowerBound T z c` is the property that `c * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x - z • x‖` for all `x : T.domain`. -/
def IsLowerBound (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (z : ℂ) (c : ℝ) : Prop := ∀ x : T.domain, c * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x - z • x‖
results.docstring: `IsLowerBound T z c` is the property that `c * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x - z • x‖` for all `x : T.domain`.

results.name: LinearPMap.isLowerBound_of_right_le
results.source_text:
lemma isLowerBound_of_right_le
    {T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} {z : ℂ} {c₁ c₂ : ℝ} (hle : c₁ ≤ c₂) (h : IsLowerBound T z c₂) :
    IsLowerBound T z c₁ :=
  fun x ↦ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (norm_nonneg x)).trans (h x)

results.name: LinearPMap.isLowerBound_of_left_le
results.source_text:
lemma isLowerBound_of_left_le
    {T₁ T₂ : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} (hle : T₁ ≤ T₂) {z : ℂ} {c : ℝ} (h : IsLowerBound T₂ z c) :
    IsLowerBound T₁ z c :=
  fun x ↦ @hle.2 x ⟨x, hle.1 x.2⟩ rfl ▸ h ⟨x, hle.1 x.2⟩

results.name: LinearPMap.isLowerBound_closure
results.source_text:
lemma isLowerBound_closure
    {T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} {z : ℂ} {c : ℝ} (h : IsLowerBound T z c) : IsLowerBound T.closure z c := by
  by_cases hT : T.IsClosable
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp <|
      hT.graph_closure_eq_closure_graph ▸ T.closure.mem_graph x
    rw [nhds_prod_eq] at hb'
    refine le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' (hb'.fst.norm.const_mul c)
      ((hb'.snd.sub <| hb'.fst.const_smul z).norm) fun n ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨y, hy₁, hy₂⟩ := (mem_graph_iff _).mp (hb n)
    exact hy₁ ▸ hy₂ ▸ h y
  · rwa [closure_def' hT]

results.name: LinearPMap.isLowerBound_neg
results.source_text:
lemma isLowerBound_neg {T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} {z : ℂ} {c : ℝ} (h : IsLowerBound T z c) :
    IsLowerBound (-T) (-z) c :=
  fun x ↦ by simpa [neg_apply, norm_neg_add] using h x

results.name: GenContFract.of_correctness_of_terminates
results.source_text:
/-- If `GenContFract.of v` terminates, then there is `n : ℕ` such that the `n`th convergent is
exactly `v`.
-/
theorem of_correctness_of_terminates (terminates : (of v).Terminates) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, v = (of v).convs n :=
  Exists.elim terminates fun n terminatedAt_n =>
    Exists.intro n (of_correctness_of_terminatedAt terminatedAt_n)
results.docstring:
If `GenContFract.of v` terminates, then there is `n : ℕ` such that the `n`th convergent is
exactly `v`.

results.name: Subgroup.IsArithmetic.finiteIndex_comap
results.source_text:
/-- If `Γ` is arithmetic, its preimage in `SL(2, ℤ)` has finite index. -/
instance IsArithmetic.finiteIndex_comap (𝒢 : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) [IsArithmetic 𝒢] :
    (𝒢.comap (mapGL (R := ℤ) ℝ)).FiniteIndex :=
  ⟨𝒢.index_comap (mapGL (R := ℤ) ℝ) ▸ IsArithmetic.is_commensurable.1⟩
results.docstring: If `Γ` is arithmetic, its preimage in `SL(2, ℤ)` has finite index.

results.name: Subgroup.isArithmetic_iff_finiteIndex
results.source_text:
lemma isArithmetic_iff_finiteIndex {Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)} : IsArithmetic Γ ↔ Γ.FiniteIndex := by
  constructor <;>
  · refine fun ⟨h⟩ ↦ ⟨?_⟩
    simpa [Commensurable, MonoidHom.range_eq_map, ← relIndex_comap,
      comap_map_eq_self_of_injective mapGL_injective] using h

results.name: ArithmeticFunction
results.source_text:
/-- An arithmetic function is a function from `ℕ` that maps 0 to 0. In the literature, they are
  often instead defined as functions from `ℕ+`. Multiplication on `ArithmeticFunctions` is by
  Dirichlet convolution. -/
def ArithmeticFunction [Zero R] :=
  ZeroHom ℕ R
results.docstring:

often instead defined as functions from `ℕ+`. Multiplication on `ArithmeticFunctions` is by
Dirichlet convolution.

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
